_comment: Build-time list of public, indexable discovery pages for sitemap.xml + prerender (seo §1, §7). Each city yields a /city/:slug URL and each service a /services/:slug URL. Slugs are ASCII and MUST mirror data/discovery.ts so the page is both crawlable and renderable. `lastmod` is an optional W3C date (YYYY-MM-DD); when omitted the build date is used.
